title: ScenarioOutcome
description: One run of a fixed reproduction scenario, before or after a candidate fix. The shared T07/I60 shape: a stable scenario_id + repro_case identify WHAT is being reproduced, run_id + base_fingerprint pin THIS execution to a specific source state, and observed records what actually happened. compare_runs() turns a before/after pair into a verdict and, crucially, refuses to call it fixed when the base never moved or the after-run's evidence is for a different repro case.

scenario_id.description: Stable identity of the reproduction scenario itself - the same across every before/after run of it.

base_fingerprint.description: Opaque fingerprint of the exact source state this run was executed against.

phase.description: Whether this run was taken before or after the candidate fix.

repro_case.description: Which specific failure case this run exercises - part of the identity a fixed result must not silently change.
